findings: @supports rule (lines 1726-1733) overrides .bottom-nav and .tab-bar padding with calc(var(--spacing) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) losing the original 6px 0 pattern; also incorrectly applies padding-bottom to .fab which is positioned via bottom property, not padding
Bottom-nav and tab-bar use left:0/right:0 spanning full viewport width while #app is constrained to max-width 480px — on desktop the nav stretches edge-to-edge creating visual inconsistency
FAB positioned with right:16px relative to viewport, not the 480px container — on wide desktop screens the FAB floats far from the centered app column
Drawer uses left:0 relative to viewport, not app container — on desktop it slides from far-left edge instead of from the 480px column edge
#app::before pseudo-element uses position:fixed inset:0 covering full viewport — radial gradient bleeds into desktop dead space outside the 480px container
#main-content padding-bottom:136px is excessive; actual bottom-nav height is ~60-70px (6px + safe-area + 48px min-height + label), leaving ~66px of unnecessary trailing scroll whitespace

.nav-label and .tab-label have min-height:44px as touch-target boost — but labels sit inside already-tall nav-item (min-height:48px, flex-column); this inflates nav height to ~67px+ and may be the real reason main-content padding is 136px

Spacing values are not on a consistent scale: section margin-bottom 14px, card padding 16px, card-header margin-bottom 12px, summary-card padding 14px 12px, bills-summary-bar padding 10px 14px, form-row gap 4px / margin-bottom 12px, section-title margin 14px 0 10px, summary-grid gap 10px — no clear 4/8 rhythm
Drawer width 280px is 58% of the 480px app; on a 360px phone max-width:80vw caps at 288px leaving only 72px visible — aggressive but within Material guidelines
